[[Freezie]] is the leader of the [[snowman|snowmen]]. It is the [[boss]] at the end of the [[dungeon]] [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]]. It also appears in the [[Wintersday]] [[quest]]s [[In Grenth's Defense]], [[The Greatest Snowman Ever Made]] and [[The Strength of Snow]].

== Location ==
* [[The Mists]]
** [[The Underworld]] (only during [[In Grenth's Defense]], level 19 Elementalist boss)
* [[Kryta]]
** {{NPC location|Nebo Terrace}} (only during [[The Greatest Snowman Ever Made]], level 20 Elementalist)
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** {{NPC location|Secret Lair of the Snowmen}} (level 19/29 Monk boss)

== Notes ==
* Appears with a blue monk boss aura in Secret Lair of the Snowmen and the Underworld.
* There is a chance to get a [[Miniature Freezie]] from a [[Birthday Present]] on your character's third birthday.
* The first time he dies in The Strength of Snow you receive a morale boost which recharges all of your skills.

==Trivia==
{{gw2w}}
*Along with [[Magmus]], [[Fronis Irontoe]], [[Maz Scourgeheart]], and [[Varny the Zealot]], Freezie is one of the only dungeon end foes to be a boss (all others are [[boss-like foes]]).
